text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When I stand at the top of the world— I 
want to make my presence known with the 
most dazzling pose.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So Biko, please give me a lesson! Teach me 
your sharp, stylish poses!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll teach you a super 
cool pose!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Extend your arms straight, like this! 
Adding a bit of twist to your hips makes 
it look great!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is it something like this!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you focus your awareness all the way 
from head to toe, it'll be even better! 
Keep your core solid, but without tensing 
up—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... This is pretty tough. Even 
though I think I'm doing it the exact same 
way...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Those supple, speedy movements! I wonder 
what your secret is?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Thanks a lot! Though, the secret to 
it, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, now that you mention it, my Trainer 
always tells me something about that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's take our time stretching! We'll keep 
at it until our joints are totally loose!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Checking if your body's moving the way you 
want as you go is super important too! And 
so—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm nicely warmed up and tired, it's 
time to dash! My body moves completely 
freely, and the speed really picks up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's the only explanation! The 
secret is my Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ever since my Trainer taught me, my hero 
poses have gotten way cooler!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...'Vile villains who disrupt the peace! 
I won't let your evil schemes succeed!'"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Kuh, who are you?! If you get in my way, 
I won't hold back!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Helping the weak, crushing evil! Justice 
Biko will be your opponent!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Justice Biko! You seem to have 
found yourself a fine Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! My Trainer is the greatest and 
strongest partner out there, after all!
